'''Emmanuel''' (Japanese: '''イブシ''' ''Ibushi'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|BW}}.

==History==
Emmanuel debuted in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where he participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament. He played a small role in the episode, where he battled [[Antonio]]'s {{p|Tranquill}} using his {{p|Scolipede}} in the first round. He was defeated by Antonio and got eliminated afterwards.

In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Emmanuel competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning that he had made it through the first round. When the screens showed the match-ups for the last sixteen in ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', Emmanuel did not appear on it, meaning he had either lost in the second round or the third round. In ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.
